subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
6. 
Trade associations complained that the Society’s pricing practices were 
distorting the agricultural export market. 
 
On the basis of preliminary inquiry, the Central Government is considering to 
direct a special audit of the Society. 
(a)  
Examine whether the Central Government is empowered to order a special 
audit in the above case. 
(b)  
State the statutory provisions governing such power. 
(c)  
Conclude whether invocation of Section 77 is justified in the given case. 
 
(4 Marks)
suggested_answer:
Verify if accrual/ provision has been made for all employee beneﬁts and 
obligations like bonus, gratuity, leave encashment, etc. 
15
